sentences.text: Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to direct respondents 1 & 2 to assign building number and issue  ownership certificate to the petitioners with respect to building situated  in their property comprised in re-survey no. re-survey No.410/11-1 of  Melthonnakkal Village forthwith dehors Exhibits-P9 and P11 to enable the  petitioners to get the compensation amount of acquisition from 3rd  respondent, pending disposal of the above writ petition.
This petition again coming on for orders upon perusing the petition  and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and this Court's order dated  23/02/2024 and

upon hearing the arguments of M/S. R.T. PRADEEP, P. BIJIMON  & M. BINDUDAS, Advocates for the petitioners and of M/S. ANJANA KANNATH &
 P.G. PRAMOD, Advocates for the respondents

, the court passed the  following:
 WP(C) No.7247/2024 2/3 Order Date : 10- Sreekala.R.S vs Mangalapuram Grama Panchayat, ... on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130315058/
1  MURALI PURUSHOTHAMAN, J.
 ========================
 W.P.(C) No. 7247 of 2024  ========================
 Dated this the 10th day of May, 2024  ORDER
There will be an interim direction to the 2 nd respondent to assign provisional building number to the building of the petitioners within a period of ten days.

Sd/-
